scope: Candidate-only P6 review packet for card-wire v1; this is not an acceptance PASS, production approval or canary authorization.

packetSize.interpretation: Bounded comparison only; the runs are not deterministic packet-for-packet replays.

serverProjectionAndSerialize.interpretation: The current native timing file is bounded and sparse; it is not a statistically sufficient performance sample.

repeatedProcessObservation.mappingMemoryAttribution: not available from process RSS alone

proposedThresholds.rationale: Values are intentionally above the observed bounded envelope with explicit headroom; they are not repository-authoritative until an independent owner approves them.

nativeCborSerialization.requiredAttribution: native Cbor::encodeArray boundary; raw bytes excluded

serverProjectionAndSerialize.requiredAttribution: separate project/request-project/serialize scopes; sample count and workload must be reviewed

mappingLifecycle.requiredAttribution: native mapping counters, not total process RSS

processObservation.required: Do not convert whole-process RSS into a mapping-memory PASS without a reviewed attribution method.

requiredReviewDecisions: Approve or replace the numeric wire, timing and mapping thresholds.
Approve workload/sample-size and confidence rules for repeated native runs.
Approve attribution method separating mapping memory from native process baseline RSS.
Record the accountable reviewer and date; no self-approval by the implementation agent.
Keep production/canary rollback SLA and independent release approval as separate gates.
limitations: The proposal does not close P6.
It does not claim exhaustive emitter, stale, replay, concurrency or long-lived room-churn coverage.
Physical device/network acceptance is OUT_OF_SCOPE_BY_USER; player feedback is a post-release monitoring input, not a pre-release PASS.
No production or canary mutation occurred.
